Here are four absolutely factual statements:

  1. This was drafted as a rewrite of SCP-952.
  2. That draft was green-lit by members of the Rewrite Team.
  3. I was later informed that this article and SCP-952 have absolutely nothing in common, and therefore,
  4. This cannot be considered a rewrite.

Statements made by Mr. djkaktus about any relation between SCP-2254 and other, unrelated articles that some could consider being similar in theme though dramatically more offensive and outright racially charged (though Mr. djkaktus makes no comment on whether or not those views are substantiated) should be considered purely coincidental and simply a result of the lack of appropriate linguistic diversity available by which a person might compare two alike but wholly unrelated and definitely not rewritten things that, again, have nothing in common with each other.
